page.layout: Two medallion portraits side by side at the top, each with a circular legend; below them one column of running text in two paragraphs; no marginal notes; signature at lower right; running head and page number at top.

main_text.l: IMP. LUDOVICUS IIII.
IMP. CAROLUS IIII AUG.[?]
LUDOVICUS Bavariæ Dux, Rudolphi Imperatoris ex
filia nepos, & Fridericus Austriæ Dux, variantibus Electorum
suffragiis, ambo Imperatores eliguntur anno mundi 5276.
à Christo nato 1314. His varia fortuna sæpe congressis, tandem
anno 8. victor Ludouicus, capto Friderico rerum potitur: sed
cùm se Imperatorem citra Papæ assensum scriberet, excommu-
nicatur. nihilominus Mediolanum venit, ubi ferream accipit
coronam: deinde Romæ summo acceptus honore à Stephano
Columnio coronatur. Petrum Corbariensem in Pontificem
creat: & oppidis iuris Pontificij alios dedit præfectos, Pontifi-
cem æmulatus, qui & ipse Galliæ Cisalpinæ multos autoritate
sua Regulos præfecerat. Imperauit Ludouicus annos 33. fumen
do[?] initium imperij eius ab excessu, & fato venenato Henrici
Lucelburgensis. Aemyl.lib.8.Egna.lib.3.
CAROLUS quartus Bohemus, Ioannis Lucelburgensis
Bohemiæ Regis, de quo dictum est supra in Henrico, filius, post
Edoardum Anglum & Guntherum Cæsares electos, Cæsar
quoque designatur: ad hunc Carolum res devenit, altero sub-
inde post alterum vita functo. Romæ itaque coronam hac con-
ditione accepit, ut confestim Italia excederet. laudem meruit
ob Auream bullam, in qua multa quæ ad pacem publicam per-
tinent, complexus est. Rerum Bohemicarum imprimis studio-
sus fuit: Pragæ gymnasium publicum instituit. obiit anno impe-
rij 32. Venceslao filio prius Cæsare creato, promissa Electoribus
pecunia, vectigalíque imperij illis obligato. Vide ut supra.

page.notes: Medallion legends are printed in the illustrations; transcribed as lines. The second legend's last word, read as AVG, is doubtful and set as AUG.[?]. "fumen do" at the line break is hard to read and may be a split word (sumendo); marked [?]. "vectigalíque" carries an accent as printed. Page number and running head are as printed (head with u/v normalised). No catchword is visible.
